scheme_name: Incentive For The Inter Caste Marriage Couple (Scheduled Tribe)
other_conditions: One spouse must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) community
The other spouse must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community
The marriage must have taken place on or after 7th February 2019
The couple must apply for the scheme within 18 months of their marriage
benefits_summary: An incentive of ₹5,50,000 is provided to the married couple (₹3,00,000 for the bride and ₹2,50,000 for the groom).
